sentence: This project studies how the structure of a neural network affects the methods used to train it, aiming to make training faster and more reliable.
This project designs a spring that works alongside an electric motor so that powered lower-limb prostheses are lighter, quieter and use less energy.
This project builds a digital twin that learns from real-time measurements how a power system behaves, so it can predict failures.
This project studies how small crustaceans called cumaceans have adapted to life in Antarctica, using their genes and genomes.
This project uses proton-proton collision data to search for particles that address questions about how the universe survived the Big Bang.
This project measures greenhouse gases from tropical wetlands and grasslands to predict how they will store and release carbon.
This project studies how soil bacteria make anthracyclines, molecules that treat cancer, and tries to mix their pathways to make related ones.
This project studies how the structure and surface of graphite affect how potassium ions move in and out of it during battery cycling.
This project builds deep learning methods that read medical sensor data without relying on misleading features, and tests them on Parkinson's disease.
This project uses surveys and interviews to find out how people from rural backgrounds feel a sense of belonging in engineering at a large university.
This project tests how salinity and harmful bacteria that build up around mature trees affect young seedlings of freshwater swamp trees.
This project builds and tests a wrist-worn camera and software that recognize what the hands are doing during daily activities of seniors.
This project brings together cybersecurity and artificial intelligence in a field called assured autonomy.
This project studies threatened species by monitoring them in the wild and by improving how they are managed in captivity.
This project studies how proteins that bind RNA help bacteria control their genes and metabolism when they face nutritional stresses.
This project builds a list of the ray-finned fishes living in the River Niger Basin and studies how their genes vary along the river.
